source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The registered header-start listener resets the S/MIME algorithm globals and calls clearCryptoDetails. That helper also clears displayed text and cipher Fluent attributes, collapses the signature/encryption groups and hides/closes the disclosure. Global-state reset and DOM-state reset are separate actions. No new test directly checks this message-switch behavior, and no native UI or asynchronous-localization race was reproduced.
title: S/MIME header starts clear displayed algorithm text and localization state
